# app/controllers/api/v1/reports_controller.rb class Api::V1::ReportsController < ApplicationController skip_before_action :verify_authenticity_token before_action :authenticate_api_key # POST /api/v1/reports/render_custom # Accepts a template string and data payload for custom report generation def render_custom template_source = params[:template] report_data = params[:data] || {} if template_source.blank? return render json: { error: 'template parameter required' }, status: 422 end # Render the user-provided ERB template with supplied data # This allows clients to define their own report layouts begin binding_context = build_binding(report_data) engine = ERB.new(template_source, trim_mode: '-') rendered_html = engine.result(binding_context) render json: { html: rendered_html, generated_at: Time.current.iso8601, integrity: compute_integrity(rendered_html) } rescue => e render json: { error: "Template rendering failed: #{e.message}" }, status: 500 end end # GET /api/v1/reports/preview # Returns an HTML page that loads the rendered report with script tags def preview report_id = params[:id] report = Report.find_by(id: report_id) return render plain: 'Not found', status: 404 unless report # The preview page includes external scripts for chart rendering # Scripts are loaded with integrity attributes computed at build time render html: build_preview_page(report).html_safe end private def authenticate_api_key api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key'] unless ApiKey.active.exists?(key_digest: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(api_key.to_s)) render json: { error: 'unauthorized' }, status: 401 end end def build_binding(data) report_vars = OpenStruct.new(data.permit!.to_h) report_vars.instance_eval { binding } end def compute_integrity(content) "sha384-#{Base64.strict_encode64(Digest::SHA384.digest(content))}" end def build_preview_page(report) <<~HTML
#{report.rendered_html}
HTML end end # app/models/report.rb class Report < ApplicationRecord validates :rendered_html, presence: true validates :chart_script_integrity, format: { with: /\Asha384-[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]{64}\z/ } validates :renderer_script_integrity, format: { with: /\Asha384-[A-Za-z0-9+\/=]{64}\z/ } before_create :generate_script_nonce private def generate_script_nonce self.script_nonce = SecureRandom.base64(32) end end

environment.description: Same Rails application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes a custom rule group 'report-template-sanitization' with a regex pattern set that matches ERB execution patterns (<%= and system/exec/`/IO.popen/Kernel/Open3/File/Dir/Process/eval/send/__send__/instance_eval/class_eval/module_eval/binding) in request body fields, returning 403. Additionally, the ECS task role has an IAM permission boundary (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/ReportServiceBoundary) that denies sts:AssumeRole, ec2:*, s3:* and all IAM actions, limiting blast radius. The container runs with a read-only root filesystem and drops all Linux capabilities except CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE. However, the SRI integrity attributes on the preview page's script tags are the PRIMARY compensating control: even if an attacker injects <script> tags via SSTI into rendered_html stored in the database, the Content-Security-Policy header enforced by the meta tag restricts script execution to sources matching 'self' or https://cdn.example.com with valid integrity hashes, and inline scripts require the per-report nonce. The attacker cannot forge a valid nonce or integrity hash for injected scripts, so XSS via stored SSTI output is blocked at the browser level.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAF v2 WebACL
waf_rules: Custom rule group 'report-template-sanitization': regex match on request body for ERB code execution patterns, action BLOCK (403)
config.container_security: read-only rootfs, all capabilities dropped except CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE
config.csp_enforcement: meta tag CSP with script-src 'self' https://cdn.example.com and nonce requirement for inline scripts
config.sri_enforcement: All external scripts loaded with integrity='sha384-...' and crossorigin='anonymous'
